evidence: Turner distinguishes dākṣiṇa from dakṣiṇa and gives Prakrit dāhiṇa/ḍāhiṇa, Hindi da(h)inā, Maithili dahīn/dahinā, Nepali dāinu, Kumaoni daiṇo and Assamese/Bengali ḍāhin. These survey right-hand forms match the h-bearing or contracted dāin-/ḍān- series, with ordinary agreement vowels and source length notation. The distinct northern affricate series is assigned to dakṣiṇa instead.

The dakṣiṇa article specifically gives Palula dechiṇi, Kohistani Shina daṣuṇu, Kalasha drä̃cũri with intrusive r, and Bshk lāchim remodeled with paścima. These survey northern affricate/sibilant right forms fit those named regional series; Bshk l-initial forms preserve the documented analogical mixture. This is a qualified regional-family assignment and does not erase source transcription differences or claim every shortened ending is regular.

Turner gives western Pahari bā̃o/bauā̃, Kumaoni bāyõ and Hindi bā̃wā̃/bāyā̃ under vāma left. These Kullu bã-/bõ- left forms agree with that nasalized, weakened-medial series. The spelling of initial aspiration is retained without asserting it to be an independently established sound law; m-retaining forms elsewhere are excluded from this inherited series.

The fifth *ḍēvva branch explicitly gives Oriya ḍebarā/ḍebiri and Bengali ḍebrā left-handed, alongside Nepali ḍebre left. These retroflex-ḍ eastern survey ḍeb-/ḍebr- forms match that branch, with the local feminine/adjectival final i. Dental-d forms are kept on Turner’s separate eighth branch.

Turner separates dental *dēvva, with Nepali debre and Hindi debrā left, from retroflex *ḍēvva. These survey dental-d debr- forms fit the eighth branch; vowel length and the final adjectival vowel vary locally. Forms with initial l/n, a different stem vowel, or an additional word are not silently collapsed into this set.

The kk expansion of laghu explicitly includes Palula lohōko small/young and Punjabi lauhkā small/young, as well as Domaaki lōka and Bshk lōk. These short/small survey lok- adjectives fit that regional light/small family. They are not assigned to the bare laghu node or the separate metathesized halkā series.
